openreads.description:
Openreads is a free, open-source book tracker designed to help readers organize their personal libraries and reading goals without advertisements, tracking, or mandatory accounts. It is a reading log and organizer rather than an ebook reader.

Keep books in four lists: Finished, Currently Reading, Want to Read, and Did Not Finish. Add titles by searching Open Library, scanning an ISBN barcode, or entering book details manually. Organize collections with customizable tags, sorting, and list ordering.

Track reading progress, record dates and ratings, and explore statistics about your reading habits. Openreads also supports custom book covers, a personalized interface, and multiple language options.

Import existing libraries from Goodreads or BookWyrm using CSV files, and export your own records for backup or migration. Book information is stored locally, while internet access is used for optional Open Library searches and book metadata.

Built with Flutter for Android and iOS, Openreads is licensed under the GNU General Public License version 2.0. It offers a simple, privacy-conscious way to keep track of what you have read and what you want to read next.
